extractions.value: Clinical features (stiffness, spasms, hyperlordosis, stimulus sensitivity), positive anti-GAD antibodies, exclusion of tetanus and seizures, response to benzodiazepines
extractions.quote: Based on the physical exam and findings during the observed episode, we believed that her attacks may represent episodes of continuous muscle activity such as seen in tetanus or SPS. The chronic course of the condition, well-documented tetanus immunization records, and lack of any recent penetrating injuries ruled out further consideration of tetanus. Her serum sample was tested for anti-glutamic acid decarboxylase (anti-GAD) antibodies, and found positive at 183 lg/mL (normal less than 0.05 lg/mL), thus supporting the diagnosis of SPS.
